items.sum: The Cougars lost their fifth straight game, 31-10 against Boise State.

items.h: Beacon Hill home becomes a haunted trail for Halloween
items.sum: A house near Comet Lodge Cemetery offers a witches' lair, corn maze and pumpkin patch at no charge, with sensory-friendly visits by appointment Oct. 26-29.

items.h: Halloween weekend roundup: Dia de Muertos, harvest fests and a zombie walk
items.sum: Pike Place Market's Dia de Muertos, a Freeway Park lantern festival, Issaquah's Zombie Walk, West Seattle Harvest Fest and the Museum of Fright top the family lineup.

items.h: Court revives lawsuit over Seattle rental rules
items.sum: An appeals ruling lets a suit from affordable-housing providers over city rental regulations move ahead.
